test_title: PYST 1: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Five friends, P, Q, R, S and T are sitting in a row facing south. Q is sitting in the centre position. P is sitting at the west end. T and R are sitting on one side of Q. Two persons are sitting between P and R. Who is sitting between Q and P?
solution:
Total five friends facing south:- P, Q, R, S and T

1) Q is sitting in the centre position.

2) P is sitting at the west end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89c6a87f2cafc968b13251f4c283f4da4ce6493c867b3197c5b98a13724a621e.png] 

3) Two persons are sitting between P and R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a78d464e6532af542fff3b41ca2ac811573ce427a2ab4c15bc48f81b646006c7.png] 

4) T and R are sitting on one side of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85d5dbacd9628be5b2e001309667910cf07eb26d4c1a1353ad484f55899d8e29.png] 

The final sitting arrangement is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04ae5bf634cd6e264738812f7ac20eeb712501b878326dcc340028e59f27d98a.png] 

Hence, 'S' is sitting between Q and P.
